reason: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset that orchestrates a bootstrap turn with minimal tools, then promotes the session to standard tools and delayed workspace instructions, with Windows shell support.

summaries.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供两阶段智能体编排的预设，先使用极简工具启动会话，再切换到完整标准工具和延迟注入的工作区指令，并支持 Windows shell。
summaries.en: A two-phase DeepSeek Harness agent preset that starts with minimal tools, then promotes the session to standard tools and delayed workspace instructions with Windows shell support.

capabilities: delays the first user message for a bootstrap turn
controls which tools are exposed before and after promotion
enables local shell execution through Git Bash, WSL, and PowerShell
